```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(nycflights13)
```

```{r}
#| label: storms-plot
#| cache: true

storms |> 
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |> 
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane"))) |> 
  distinct(year, name, status) |> 
  count(year, status) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "lightblue",
      "tropical storm" = "orange",
      "hurricane" = "darkred"
    ),
    labels = c("Tropical Depression", "Tropical Storm", "Hurricane")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Storms per Year by Type",
    subtitle = "Data from the dplyr storms dataset",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Storms",
    fill = "Storm Type"
  )
```

flights

#| label: flights-plot

flights |>
